BL-1232 — Briefing shift-velocity chart is unreadable — outlier-crushed Y axis, colliding date labels, one gap eating the plot
What it solves: - [2026-08-28] specifier: minted from the intake. The intake listed three
  failures; failures 2 and 3 are one root cause (unnormalized log-of-raw-ms
  warp), verified by arithmetic against nonLinearTimeX: for a 30-day series
  the age-1-day point maps to x = padL + 0.157 * plotW while age-0 maps t…
Approval context: The intake delegated the Y-axis remediation shape to the specifier. The shape chosen here is soft-cap plus clipped-peak callout (not a broken axis, not a log Y): the axis fits the body of the series, and any day above the cap is drawn as a distinct marker sitting on the cap line carrying its true v…
